newsitem.title: CHINA: Bridge collapses in south China, many casualties.
newsitem.headline: Bridge collapses in south China, many casualties.

text.p: A bridge under construction in southern China has collapsed, killing or injuring as many as 100 people, most of them workers at the site, officials and local residents said by telephone on Saturday.

A 100-metre (yard) section of the 160-metre bridge linking Pingshi county with Ruyuan county in Guangdong province gave way on Friday morning, an official of the local television station said by telephone.
Many people had been killed or injured in the disaster, and rescue workers at the site were still trying to compile a specific casualty figure, he said.

However, a local resident living near the bridge said about 100 people had been killed or injured, most of them migrant workers from Henan and Hebei provinces in central and north China who were building the bridge.

Rescue workers, backed by police and men from the paramilitary People's Armed Police, had worked through the night searching for survivors buried under the debris of the bridge, the television official said.
Officials from the nearby city of Shaoguan in the north of the province had rushed to the scene to direct the rescue operation, the television official said.
